text_block_list.text:
After the break.
I spotted Narita Brian on the academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I went out to the countryside on an inspection for the student council.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Still, she's a chairwoman who loves a good time.
She'll definitely insist on trying local food, soaking in hot springs, and all that...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Honestly.
Calling this an "inspection" is a total joke.
Going out with her friend seemed to give her a nice break!
